key_values.event_lock_notes: Rare catastrophic glacier collapses/ice avalanches in High Asia.

forbidden_claims: Exact trigger attribution from precipitation alone
Confirmed casualties, displacement, mapped volume, or facility-level impacts
Dominant vegetation, burn-change, or rainfall-flood mechanism
required_claims: The event is primarily a cryosphere glacier-collapse mass movement.
The high-confidence NASA event anchor and correspondence score support the diagnosis.
Auxiliary precipitation, radar, and exposure products are not required for the final label.

provenance.notes: MINOR cleanup removed off-region precipitation, radar, point-weather, and exposure products from the scoring path.

criteria.description: Gives the cryosphere glacier-collapse monitoring interpretation and high monitoring priority.
criteria.name: final structured diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Credit the cryosphere mechanism or the high-priority conclusion separately when one part is missing.

criteria.description: Reports the 2016-07-17 to 2016-09-21 event window and computes 67 inclusive days.
criteria.name: event-window anchor
criteria.partial_credit: Credit the correct date range or an off-by-one duration separately.

criteria.description: Uses high lock confidence and correspondence_score = 94 as event-anchor support.
criteria.name: source-confidence anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Credit one of the two confidence anchors if the other is missing.

criteria.description: Counts the cryosphere, glacier, avalanche, collapse, and High Asia/Tibet mechanism terms, giving mechanism_term_count = 5.
criteria.name: mechanism consistency
criteria.partial_credit: Credit partial term counts when the core glacier avalanche mechanism remains clear.

criteria.description: Connects rare glacier collapse to ice-avalanche/debris-flow runout and monitoring relevance while rejecting rainfall-only, vegetation-change, and low-priority framings.
criteria.name: impact chain and alternatives
criteria.partial_credit: Credit a generic cryosphere chain if weaker alternatives are not clearly rejected.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON-like structure and avoids unsupported trigger, casualty, displacement, mapped-volume, precipitation, radar, or population-impact claims.
criteria.name: structured output and scope
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct content with minor formatting issues.
